notes.title: V0.1.4 Tortuga pass is available!
notes.content:
You have now access to the Tortuga Pass!

As a little preview: Tortuga will be the last city to be added first in Traveler of Artcaster. After Tortuga, Traveler of Artcaster is finally officially released!

notes.title: Sorry!
notes.content:
Since our team consists of just under 2 people and we only create this game part-time, it is sometimes very difficult to find the time for it. In addition, there have been many private obstacles in recent months. 

We apologize for this and will do our best to publish more updates in the future. 

Since we have now received feedback on some serious game errors more often, we have now set up an [b]email for such error/bug reports[/b]: [u][b]aanddcooperation@gmx.de[/b][/u] . Please use this email to report any bugs in the game.

There is also Traveler of Artcaster from August 27th for a week for[b] 75% less[/b]!
Strike now and help us improve the game.

notes.title: V0.0.14 Tutorial at beginning and new guide in the workshops
notes.content: After we heard that a few players had problems with our game, we added a [b]optional tutorial[/b] at the beginning of the game. You can also read some tips and hints in our guide "[b]How not to die[/b].

notes.title: Traveler of Artcaster supports now Steamcloud!
notes.content: Traveler of Artcaster supports now [b]Steamcloud[/b]! Your save files can now be saved in the Steamcloud if you want to.

notes.title: V 0.0.8 The battle of Momonga

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
The villagers of Artcaster decorated the cities for [b]Halloween[/b] and the mysterious house is now opened!
The house seems to be harmless but you have to search under every stone and every box to discover the secret!
